question: For the v0.1.x migration, should legacy `@openclaw/design-system` consumers receive only tokens shipped by the released CSS, or should the matching Carapace CSS/package migration ship before this guidance is regenerated?
rationale: The generated downstream repository cannot safely choose an upstream package compatibility and release contract, and either choice changes the guidance given to existing consumers.

options.title: Preserve the released legacy contract
options.body: Version-gate or remove unsupported tokens from canonical compatibility guidance, then let the daily sync regenerate this PR.

options.title: Ship the matching Carapace contract
options.body: Release CSS containing the documented tokens and migrate the legacy consumer guidance to the matching package/version with explicit upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause this generated refresh
options.body: Keep the skill sync out of the repository until the upstream contract is settled and reproducibly consumable.

recommendation.title: Preserve the released legacy contract
recommendation.body: Version-gate or remove unsupported tokens from canonical compatibility guidance, then let the daily sync regenerate this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review contains the concrete released-package verification and the two viable upstream contract paths.
